scenes.setting: The dining-room duel: Harras's metal glove of authority (Exile, prohibitions, 'Death!') and Katy's soul-searing whip burn through three paper substitutes — but the whole fight was misdirection: the poison masked the smell of the gas pipes Klein ruptured under cover of the flaring lamps; a snap of the fingers, and Confinement seals the fireball in with them
scenes.text_anchor: That abnormal smell was the smell of gas!
